explanation: Build a balanced tree in inorder while consuming the sorted doubly linked list once. Recursively build the left half, use the current original list node as root and consume the right half; prev and next become tree-child links.
spaceComplexity: O(log(n+1)) recursion space, reusing the original nodes.
